name: Service trust constrained by aws:SourceAccount - confused-deputy constraint, still informational
note: IAM-805 (service confused-deputy constraint variant). A service principal (cloudtrail.amazonaws.com) trust pinned with aws:SourceAccount stays a normal, hardened service relationship (informational) and never an external/escalation finding.
rationale: aws:SourceAccount compares the account that initiated the request and is available only when the call is made directly by a service principal; AWS lists it as a sensitive key for which wildcards have no valid use case. Used in a service-principal trust it is a confused-deputy CONSTRAINT tying the assume to a specific initiating account. This remains an ordinary service-role relationship: it stays informational (TRUST-SERVICE) and must never be raised to an external-account, public, or escalation finding, and licences no inference about the assumed role's permissions (out of scope / unknown). Ref: AWS global condition key aws:SourceAccount; docs/trust-policy-semantics.md sec 4.3 and 5.
